description: Defines the CartScreen and supporting widgets for displaying and managing shopping cart contents in a Flutter app, including navigation to checkout.

classes.name: CartScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying the user's shopping cart items, totals, and a checkout button.

classes.name: _Totals
classes.description: A widget for displaying subtotal, delivery, tax, and total cost summaries.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the CartScreen widget, including the list of cart items, totals, and navigation button.

methods.name: _row
methods.description: Helper method in _Totals to create a labeled row of cost information.
